# Modal

Blocking dialog for confirmations and short focused tasks.

`Icyre.Modal` · Overlays

## Use

```jsx
<Icyre.Modal open title="…">…</Icyre.Modal>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Icyre.Modal" open="{{yes}}" title="…">…</x-import>
```
